help.label: Help: editing notes
help.text_html: Local editing mode. Changes are saved automatically to data/working.sqlite. Editing stays local until “Transfer to TV” is explicitly confirmed. Before every write the TV database is backed up and its state is checked again. According to the LG input dialog, new channel numbers must be between 1 and 99. Existing higher channel numbers remain unchanged. If a target number in 1–99 is occupied, the two channel slots can be swapped. Ambiguous assignments stay blocked; automatic numbering with several slot changes is verified step by step on the TV.
